_comment: Static deploy of the repo root. Nothing about the folder layout changes — these rewrites just
Why / would 404 without this: there is no index.html at the repo root; the playable file lives
Why the /assets rule is needed as well: the built HTML references its assets RELATIVELY
(assets/Audio/..., assets/Images/..., assets/UI/...). A rewrite keeps the browser URL at /, so
those resolve to /assets/... — which does not exist at the root. The second rule maps them back
under 3_CURRENT_BUILD. Without it the page would load and every picture and clip would 404.
NOTE ON SECRETS: rewrites are evaluated AFTER the filesystem, so a deployed file is always
served and no rule here can hide one. 3_CURRENT_BUILD/.env is kept out of the deployment
instead — it is git-ignored (verified never committed) and listed in .vercelignore.
